caption: The drawing depicts three objects arranged in a triangular composition on a plain light beige background. In the upper left, there is a cylindrical hat box rendered in shades of brown and tan, with a slightly mottled texture suggesting an aged or worn surface. In the upper right, there is a simple line drawing outline of a top hat with a flat brim and a ribbon tied in a bow on the lower right side of the crown; this outline lacks any color or shading. Centered and occupying the lower half of the image is a fully rendered top hat in light brown, textured to resemble woven straw or similar material, featuring a wide black ribbon around its base with a bow on the right side. The drawing uses a restrained color palette primarily consisting of shades of brown, black, and tan, with the only portion left in outline being the rightmost top hat.
title: Man's Straw Hat
